Definition: of Latin origin but uncertain significance; Titus, a Christian:--Titus.
BiblicalUsage: Titus is Paul's brother and his trusted messenger. Paul had no rest in his spirit at Troas because he found not Titus, and at the end of Paul's life Titus has gone to Dalmatia, still carrying the work forward.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Titus shows the kind of friendship the gospel makes: a brother Paul cannot rest without, and a worker who keeps going when Paul can go no further. I hold that the church runs on such men.
